summary: Short, steep kerb on a quiet street, with homes 11-12 m away.
reasons: Homes 11-12 m away on same side
Only 15 m long, one van length

drivers.seclusion: Townhouses 10-12 m behind the kerb; more homes 21 m or more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide street, with cars parked at this kerb in the imagery; room for a van is tight at 15 m.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the north kerb; no signs.

flags: Very short stretch, barely a van length
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees to the north-west and the townhouses shade the kerb from the north in the morning.

best_section.where: North kerb of Greenlaw Street, west of the corner, outside the townhouses
